environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on AKS cluster in namespace 'webapp-prod'. Exposed via Kubernetes Ingress (nginx-ingress-controller) with TLS termination. No Istio sidecar injection. Session cookies have SameSite=None and Secure=true to support cross-origin SSO flow with identity provider on separate domain. CORS policy allows credentials from *.corp-apps.internal. No anti-forgery middleware configured.
